'''YEAH!''' is the eighth ending for [[Pokémon Sunday]], replacing {{OBP|Battle Frontier|Japanese song}} and being followed by [[Spurt!]]. It's a Eurobeat song that was produced in 2005, and released in 2006. Originally sung by an Italian singer Christina Tosi under the alias of Christine, it was later covered by the J-Pop group {{wp|Hinoi Team}} (Japanese: '''HINOIチーム''' lit. ''Hinoi Chīmu'') and was featured in one of the group's albums, along with other songs by them, though the cover was released first a month before the original song on Super Eurobeat Vol. 167 by Avex Trax.

==Synopsis==
The music video features Hinoi Team dancing and singing along with people [[Pokémon cosplay|dressed in Pokémon costumes]].
